title: Give your PMs clear ownership, then step back
summary: Your PMs grow when they own real problems and decisions. Agree who decides what, and resist taking decisions back.

beginner: List the main decisions in your area.
For each, agree who decides: you, your PM or both.
Support your PMs' decisions, even when you'd have chosen differently.
Review the split every few months.
intermediate: Use clear levels of delegation, from tell to fully delegate.
Delegate more as trust and skills grow.
Give your PMs problems to solve, not features to build.
experienced: Set delegation norms across your product organisation.
Spot when leaders are taking decisions back.
Build a team that can run without you day to day.

toolExamples.miro: Map decisions against levels of delegation.
